android.desc:
With an outstanding pace of AI technologies, many things become possible, even the most unbelievable. Revoice Voice Convertor is another astonishing neural network that can convert your voice into the voice of any person or read text with any voice.

★ Edit your Instagram stories, reels, or TikTok videos
   to create outstanding content that will keep your audience heated.
★ Edit any video to change the voice of the speaker.
★ Create sound recordings that mimic the voices of your friends,
   relatives, or celebrities, and share them as audio files or voice messages.
★ Prank those who deserve it. Your companion would believe to be listening to any person of your choice. 
★ Make funny congrats to your loved ones, from anyone!
★ Personalised audio messages from celebrities.
★ Text 2 speech synthesis with any voice of your choice. 

Usage is really simple: record your own voice/video, or upload your own voice/video, up to 2 minutes -> Chose any of the predefined presets, or create your own -> convert -> share results.

In case you are interested in text to speech, usage is the same: write the text -> chose voice from the huge list of predefined voices -> synthesise the text -> take advantage from the astonishing result, as if your text was read by desired person itself.

If you need to convert your voice, get our voice convertor and have fun. With this celebrity voice convertor, you can create any voice, including the voices of famous people. Voice swap is easy - check it out now.

Conversion/synthesis results are always concatenated with our watermark sound as a necessary feature to comply with the rules. We omit the watermark if you use custom presets/voices.
